layers.name: format_preserving
capabilities: cue-disambiguated bank account and student ID
numeric and Thai-month date with birth-cue upgrade
address components and cue-gated postal code

normalization.whole_input: length-preserving Thai-digit-to-ASCII detection shadow; otherwise exact hosted text
normalization.offset_contract: Python character offsets into the exact submitted text
pattern_local: spaces and hyphens are removed locally for Thai-ID and card checksum validation
supported phone and identifier patterns accept only their documented separators
case handling is pattern-specific; email accepts mixed case while IBAN and passport patterns are uppercase

post_processing: strong record-name relabeling cannot displace FP spans or uncover a wider overlap
adjacent address components may be coalesced into one ADDRESS span
retained address spans may be boundedly extended from an overlapping TB address
facility-like locations may be dropped only under bounded notice-register evidence

section26.semantics: keyword-based, first-match-per-category heuristic signal; flag only and not automatic redaction or legal classification

protection.token: request-vault pseudonym with a type label and randomized namespace; reversible for the request and not anonymization
protection.surrogate: deterministically seeded format-natural or Thai synthetic replacement with collision checks; reversible for the request and not anonymization
protection.outbound_policy: sanitized text is rechecked for structured, detector, residual, and replacement-integrity signals before provider use

known_boundaries: automated detection can produce false positives and false negatives
name, organization, and location behavior depends on the bundled local Thai NER plus bounded heuristics
unsupported formatting such as inserted zero-width characters is not globally normalized away
Section 26 output is a heuristic keyword signal, not PDPA compliance accuracy
internal detector scores are implementation priorities and are not public calibrated confidence
a successful outbound rescan does not prove that an unrecognized identifier cannot exist
